text:
Tessa: Harmonic Systems asked if we can onboard their "Harmonic-Llama-35b" variant for a 3-week POC. Key asks: custom tokenizer, 4-bit quant, KMS + VPC, and per-call committed pricing.
Ravi: Quick check  our catalog loads a compatible variant named llama-harmonic-35b-v1 but tokenizer is stock BPE. Request tokenizer files (tokenizer.json + merges) before we accept as supported.
Kim: Note on quant: our 4-bit path supports GPT-style attention and should run, but wer seeing potential p95 tail when seq>1024. Recommend early perf tests.
Evan: For pricing, hosted per-token estimate: $0.01 / 1k tokens for generation. For a small dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv) estimate: $4k/mo committed. We can provide burst credits.
Tessa: Action items: 1) Ask customer for tokenizer artifacts and a sample corpus (sent). 2) Run perf profile for 4-bit vs fp16. 3) Fill security QS and confirm KMS flow.
Ravi: Running perf now. snippet:```bash
redwood perf --model llama-harmonic-35b-v1 --quant 4bit --seq 2048 --batch 4
# p50 88ms/token
# p95 340ms/token
```Logs -> https://redwood.internal/tickets/9876
Ravi: Also noted kv-cache mismatch when their tokenizer inserts special tokens; I can add a small preprocessor in adapter to remap tokens.
Kim: If p95 ~340ms suggest dedicated or lowering batch; also enable prefix caching for chat to drop token costs.
Evan: Ir drafting a 3-option pricing sheet: hosted pay-as-you-go, monthly reserved, and private deployment setup fee. Will include examples for 100k and 1M tokens.
redwood-deploy-bot: Ticket 9876 created and assigned to #sales, #eng-ml.
Tessa: I'll send POC plan to Harmonic: week 1 tokenization + test corpus, week 2 perf + config, week 3 security + optional private trial. I'll ask for their expected RPS and retention requirements (logs).
Evan: One more enterprise note: if they want logs retained >90 days we need enterprise addendum and updated SLA.
Kim: Ir preparing a short runbook for tokenization fixes (strip merges, remap special tokens) to attach.
Tessa: Thanks team. Ir asking them for artifacts now; will update once they reply :thumbsup:
